latest.title: New extremal Kähler metrics on projective bundles
latest.abstract: Consider a holomorphic vector bundle $E$ over a compact complex curve $C$ which decomposes as a sum of stable vector bundles. For the projectivization $\mathbb{P}(E)$, we prove that the existence of a compatible extremal almost Kähler (aK) metric of involutive type in the sense of Lejmi is equivalent to the existence of a Calabi extremal Kähler metric. This result rests on the Yau--Tian--Donaldson correspondence in terms of the moment polytope $Δ$ for $\mathbb{P}(E)$, proved by the author and Yin in a previous work. The main advantage is that compatible extremal aK metrics of involutive type are solutions to a second-order linear PDE, rather than a fourth-order nonlinear PDE for Calabi's extremal Kähler metrics. As an application, we prove that when $E$ has rank $4$ and $C$ is an elliptic curve or the projective line, $\mathbb{P}(E)$ is a Calabi dream manifold, i.e. admits an extremal Kähler metric in every Kähler class.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 刻画曲线上分裂稳定向量丛的射影化何时存在 Calabi 极值 Kähler 度量，并构造新的 Calabi dream 流形。
latest.breakthrough: 把四阶极值 Kähler 问题等价转化为 involutive 型 almost-Kähler 度量的二阶线性问题。
latest.limitations: 基底限于紧复曲线且向量丛须分解为稳定直和；dream 结论针对秩四和特定曲线。
